title: Cosmic Reaper on Cliff
description: A skeletal figure in a dark hooded robe stands in an old wooden boat perched on a mossy rock cliff. The skeleton has long purple tentacles instead of a body and is reaching out with golden skeletal hands while a pink octopus like creature with big green eyes and many tentacles floats beside it under a starry sky with swirling green and blue galaxies.
prompt: A skeletal figure wearing a dark hooded robe stands inside an old wooden boat on top of a mossy rocky cliff. The skeleton has long dripping purple tentacles for a body and reaches out with golden skeletal hands. Next to it floats a pink octopus creature with large green eyes and many tentacles. The background is a dark starry sky filled with swirling green and blue galaxies and a glowing spiral nebula.
